_comment_AllowedHosts: Restrictive example for reference (F-13). In production set the real hostname. 'localhost' is a safe local-dev value; the tracked appsettings.json keeps '*' so plain local runs are not broken.

Cors._comment: Local dev frontend origins only (F-07). Adjust to match your frontend dev-server port.

Jwt._comment: Do NOT paste a real key here. The value below is a deliberate PLACEHOLDER that is under 32 bytes, so copying this file verbatim FAILS the startup guard (F-12) instead of shipping a known, guessable signing key. Generate your own strong key and supply it via .NET user-secrets: dotnet user-secrets set 'Jwt:Key' "$(openssl rand -base64 48)" — or the Jwt__Key env var in prod. Must be >= 32 bytes.
